sourceReviews.review: All14 exact full types, standard axioms, theorem roles and proof sources read. Concrete final theorem: for ANY commutative Noetherian R and ANY actual quasi-coherent O_SpecR-module M,ALL positive NATIVE SHEAF H and GLOBAL unit Ext vanish. Not assumed:Cech-H comparison,affine acyclicity,Serre bound,canonical duality. Noetherian hypothesis is explicit. Injective R-module image is proved flasque,not claimed injective as a module sheaf. Artin-Rees kills relations and actual localization fractions produce original open sections. Generic pointed exact-functor premises are discharged. Original4.1/4.2/main and projective Serre-bound existence remain OPEN.
